contexts.text: The sons from Tamar = the two essentials of the Church... Perez = faith.
She called his name Perez () = the quality; namely, of the separation of truth from good apparently... For, in the Original Language, Perez is a breach.

The sons of Judah, Er and Onan, and Shelah, and Perez, and Zarah () = celestial love, and its doctrinal things... The sons of Perez, Hezron, and Hamul () = the truths of this good, which are the goods of charity.
